tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Window background behind every panel. Never put text straight on a wash; put it on ground or a surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, metric cards, navigation rail and clock bar, on ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Default buttons, menus, tooltips, dialogs and the hovered table row, on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Input wells, table header strip, progress tracks, segmented control tray.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: panel borders, table row dividers, chart grid. Carries no meaning on its own.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that identify a control (buttons, inputs, select) and unflown route track. 3:1 on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures on ground, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, column headers, secondary text and idle icons on ground, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text and competitor routes on the map only. Below 4.5:1 by design; never use it for text that must be read.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand amber as a fill: primary button, selected segment, own hub marker. Always a filled shape carrying on-accent text, never thin lines or text.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of anything filled with accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent as text or thin mark: selected nav item, selected tab underline, own routes, default progress fill. On ground, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and accent-wash.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Selected table row and selected nav item. Text on it is ink, ink-muted or accent-text.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Needs attention soon: maintenance due, low reserve. Text and glyph of the caution chip, on ground, surfaces and caution-wash. Same amber as accent-text today; kept as its own token so caution can move to another hue without touching selection.

tokens.name: caution-wash
tokens.usage: Background of the caution chip.

tokens.name: go
tokens.usage: Positive result: profit, on time, crew complete. Text and marks on ground, surfaces and go-wash. Sits toward blue so it is told apart from stop without relying on red against green.

tokens.name: go-wash
tokens.usage: Background of the go chip.

tokens.name: stop
tokens.usage: Loss, blocked operation, destructive action. Text and marks on ground, surfaces and stop-wash; fill of the confirming danger button with on-stop text.

tokens.name: on-stop
tokens.usage: Text on a stop fill.

tokens.name: stop-wash
tokens.usage: Background of the stop chip and hovered outline danger button.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Neutral information and airborne state: in-flight chip, retraining in progress. Text and marks on ground, surfaces and sky-wash.

tokens.name: sky-wash
tokens.usage: Background of the info chip.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every focusable control. 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: flap
tokens.usage: Split-flap cell of the clock readout. Stays dark in both themes, like a real departure board.

tokens.name: flap-ink
tokens.usage: Characters on flap cells.

tokens.name: flap-seam
tokens.usage: The 1px hinge line across the middle of each flap cell. Decorative.

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: Sea on the world map.

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: Land on the world map. Coastline is line.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the screen behind a dialog.

styles.name: screen-title
styles.usage: One per screen, top left of the content area.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Panel headers and tabs. Always uppercase.

styles.name: column-head
styles.usage: Table column titles. Always uppercase, ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels and metric captions. Always uppercase, ink-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Drei ATR 72-600 bedienen EDDF–EDDM mit acht Landungen pro Tag.
styles.usage: Default for everything that is a sentence, and for table text cells.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels and the lead phrase of an attention entry.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Enthält offene Gehälter der laufenden Periode.
styles.usage: Help text under inputs, tooltip body, secondary line in a list row.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The value of a metric card.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Every number in a table, right-aligned, and every numeric input.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: ICAO codes, registrations, flight numbers, chip text, chart axis ticks.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between flap cells; icon to its label inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a control; label to its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding; gap between controls in a row; panel header vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel and card padding; gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Content area margin; gap between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; space above a screen title.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, flap cells, progress tracks, segments inside a segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, select, tooltip.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, metric cards, table frame, menus, dialog.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: The only shadow. Menus, tooltips and dialogs, which float above the layout. Panels never cast one.
